armature_model.status: Rotor inertia is an engineering estimate because the supplied Steadywin workbook does not publish it. Replace these values when measured or vendor rotor inertia becomes available.
armature_model.ankle_note: The symmetric two-motor differential contributes both motor inertias to each equivalent ankle axis; equal motor assumptions cancel the pitch-roll cross term.

recovery_torque_basis.note: Conservative whole-body moment-arm checks for difficult recovery poses. They justify the approved short-duration simulation clamps but are not substitutes for trajectory-level thermal and structural validation.

ankle_transmission.note: Fusion contains two motor-output revolute joints and four passive rod pivots per ankle. The URDF keeps equivalent pitch/roll output joints because its tree format cannot directly carry this closed kinematic loop.

cdc_niosh_anthropometry.note: Standing stature and acromiale-height tables support a shoulder-height target near 81-82 percent of stature.

nasa_anthropometric_source_book.note: Used as a general reference for standing anthropometric landmarks; robot clearances remain design-specific.

references.mass_target_reasoning: A 39 kg completed target lies between the official G1 and H1 masses at an intermediate 1.524 m height. This pass models 38 kg, including leg actuator packages plus torso battery/electronics mass placement; 1 kg remains reserved for wiring, covers, fasteners, and final tuning.

design_intent.ankles: Two GIM6010-36 motor outputs and two jointed rods per ankle drive the equivalent pitch/roll axes. The 40 mm cranks and 46 mm output arms give 1.15:1 torque multiplication and 41.4:1 effective motor-to-joint reduction.
design_intent.actuators: Approved short-duration Isaac peak clamps, separate continuous ratings, joint speed clamps, and reduction-dependent reflected armatures are assigned by joint family.
design_intent.arms: Minimal functional arm: shoulder pitch, shoulder roll, elbow pitch on each side.
design_intent.mass_notice: The modeled links total 38 kg; 1 kg is reserved for wiring, covers, fasteners, and final tuning. Fusion bodies are density-calibrated by component to their assigned link masses.
